summary.text: Melissa Wintrow represents Idaho Senate District 19, and the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory lists Wintrow as Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: The directory biography says Wintrow was born in Troy, Ohio, and holds a B.A. in English literature from Miami University and an M.Ed. in higher education from the University of Georgia.
It says Wintrow has more than 30 years of service in higher education and owns SAGA Strategic Solutions, a communication and leadership consultancy.
